_disclaimer: Representative zone-class speed limits used by DriveGuard AI's own configurable zones (src/config.py:SPEED_ZONES). Actual posted limits vary by exact stretch and state notification under Section 112 of the MV Act — always defer to on-ground signage.

state_highway_notes.Maharashtra: Expressways (e.g. Mumbai-Pune) permit up to 100 kmph for LMVs; state highways typically 80 kmph.
state_highway_notes.Delhi: Ring Road and arterial roads generally capped at 60-70 kmph; residential/school zones as low as 25 kmph.
state_highway_notes.Karnataka: Bengaluru city roads generally 50-60 kmph; NICE Road and outer ring road corridors up to 70-80 kmph.
state_highway_notes.Tamil Nadu: Chennai city arterial roads 50-60 kmph; national highways within state up to 100 kmph for LMVs.

vehicle_class_modifiers.note: Heavy goods and passenger vehicles (trucks, buses) are typically subject to lower class-specific limits than light motor vehicles on the same stretch, per Rule 3 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules.
